title: Book Three · Chapter 115: The Price of the Journey
story:
Two weeks later, Anna asks Ronan to walk to the bus station with her.

It is Saturday morning. Her request for course information is already in the post. Today she wants to ask about the journey.

Ronan meets her beside the bread shop. She has her notebook. He has two pieces of bread from home in his bag.

They walk past the market and reach the station before lunch.

Anna looks at the board above the ticket window. She finds the city from the course page.

“There.”

Ronan follows her finger. The name is much farther down the board than their local stops.

At the window, Anna asks about a morning bus.

“Seven,” the woman says. “The journey takes about three hours.”

Anna writes both times.

“And a seat?”

“Six yuan each way, at present.”

“Twelve there and back?”

“Yes. Check again near your travel date.”

Anna thanks her. She asks about the last bus home too. It leaves the other city at six in the evening.

Outside, she stops beside the wall and finishes her notes.

“We could see quite a lot,” Ronan says.

Anna looks up. “For a visit, yes.”

He looks at the six o'clock time. He pictured a day out together. Her course page describes a much longer stay.

“You mean living there.”

“Later. Perhaps. I need to know about the classes first.”

Ronan nods. A bus moves slowly past the gate. He watches the people behind its windows.

Anna closes the notebook.

“Twelve is only the journey,” she says. “There would be food too.”

“And something to drink.”

“Yes.”

He opens his bag and gives her one piece of bread.

“Today, I have that part.”

She laughs and takes it. They find a low wall away from the entrance.

The bread is a little flat. Ronan's school book was on top of it.

“A thin lunch,” Anna says.

“It has had a difficult journey.”

She takes another bite. He eats his own piece and looks at her new notes.

She has written a question below the bus times: Where do students sleep?

He nearly says they can find a room together. Instead, he asks about the word beside it.

“Does the school have rooms?”

“That is in my letter.”

They finish the bread and walk back through the market. Anna stops to look at a building across the road. A man comes down with a long parcel. A woman stops at the bottom to let him pass. Behind her, another person has to wait on the pavement.

Anna moves a little way along the wall. From there, she can see the side of the steps.

“Would you put the door somewhere else?” Ronan asks.

“I want to see the inside first.”

“Not through the window?”

“Not today.”

She smiles and puts her notebook away. The people at the steps have room again.

Ronan waits beside her. Then they walk on.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

each way＝单程、每个方向；at present＝目前；travel date＝出行日期；entrance＝入口。

## 理解问题

1. 目前单程和往返车费各是多少？工作人员有没有保证以后价格不变？
2. Ronan最先想象的是怎样的出行？Anna还在问哪一种更长远的生活安排？

## 读句子

**The journey takes about three hours.**

拆开看：The journey / takes / about three hours.

这趟路程／需要／大约三个小时。
